t: Embracing AI-Assisted Development with Jupyter AI and Nix Flakes
s: This article proposes a FOSS-centric development workflow combining Jupyter AI for coding assistance, Nix Flakes for reproducible environments, and FastHTML for web app development, enabling local, cloud-like development.
sub: Jupyter AI integration with Ollama and Llama3.1 for local AI coding assistance.
Nix Flakes for deterministic, reproducible development environments across platforms.
FastHTML framework for Pythonic web development utilizing ASGI, HTMX, Starlette, and Uvicorn.
Zero-cost local cloud development methodology via Nix/NixOS.
